_comment: Songs with NO single meaningful tempo — multi-movement or heavily rubato — dropped from the dataset because they're useless as a 'what does X BPM feel like' anchor: there's no stable pulse to memorize, and any single number (Deezer's or a curated override) represents only one section. Key = 'artist|title', normalized at load like bpm_overrides.json. Applied as a final filter, so a song here is dropped even if it has a BPM or an override. Hand-maintained — the set of famous tempo-shifting songs is small and well-known. Excluded songs are logged to gaps.json under an 'excluded:' marker on each run.
exclude: _below: obvious multi-tempo songs not presently in the set; harmless no-ops until they appear
the beatles|a day in the life
